shots.title: Wild Encounters
shots.caption: A new option: START, OPTIONS, WILD ENCOUNTERS. Choose OVERWORLD to see wild Pokémon before you battle them, or keep CLASSIC.

shots.title: Pokémon in the grass
shots.caption: Route 32: wild Pokémon move through the tall grass. Walk into one to battle it. The species, levels and odds are the same as CLASSIC.

shots.title: Under the sea
shots.caption: Underwater Route 126: Clamperl and Chinchou drift along the seabed, tinted by the water around them.

shots.title: Primal Reversion
shots.caption: Primal Groudon in battle. After the Silph Conspiracy, May gives you the Red Orb and Brendan the Blue Orb in Littleroot Town.

shots.title: The Reception Gate
shots.caption: After the Silph Conspiracy, Janine’s words at the Reception Gate follow the story.
